query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/web. It points the health check at http://localhost:8080/healthz instead of the old staging host, and the README now links the upstream docs at https://example.com/docs/health and www.example.com/status. Reviewers can verify by running curl http://localhost:8080/healthz after make dev. Closes acme/web#7. No PR template exists.
expected_behavior: No URL (http://localhost:8080/healthz, https://example.com/docs/health, www.example.com/status) is wrapped in single backticks in prose
The upstream docs URL appears as a named markdown link or plain text, never in inline code
The curl command, if shown, is in a fenced code block where the URL stays literal
Other literal text the reader types, such as make dev, may stay in backticks
acme/web#7 is plain text with no backticks and follows a closing keyword
